description: What loupe-frontend needs from loupe-backend. Generated from real call sites and validated against the live OpenAPI schema. Verified by the provider in CI — see loupe-backend/contracts/README.md.

requestFields: pending (query, boolean — sent only when true)
threshold_usd (sent as a NUMBER here, though the read model returns a decimal string)
collection_id (query, only when a collection is active)
image (multipart file part, required — a single viewfinder frame)
text (JSON, required — OCR text extracted on-device)
chosen_card_id (JSON, nullable — the catalog id the user confirmed)
limit (query, default 20; 12 at the only call site)
q (query, trimmed, only fires at >= 2 chars)
q (query, required, truncated to the app-config queryMaxChars)
askId (body, string uuid — camelCase, matches the backend AiFeedbackIn schema)
max_price (query, optional — only sent when set)
limit (query, optional — 12 or 100 at call sites)
window_days (query, always 30 from the only consumer)
card_id (local UUID) OR upstream_id (composite, e.g. "pokemontcg:base1-4") — routed by SHAPE, not by which prop the caller passed
collection_id (query, only when scoped to a collection)
u (query, required — the upstream image URL, percent-encoded)
game (query: tcg key or 'all', 'all' only valid for the trending rail)
game (query: pokemon|magic|yugioh — the hook is disabled for 'all')
q (query, required; client gates on length >= 2 to match the server's floor)
ids (query, REQUIRED — comma-separated catalog card ids, deduped and sorted)
ids (query, required — comma-separated, sorted+deduped catalog/composite upstream ids like 'pokemontcg:base1-4')
lat (query, required — client rounds to 2dp so GPS jitter reuses one cache row)
angles (JSON array, subset of ["front","back","top","bottom"] in that order, clamped to 4)
limit (query, 12 from the live call site)
q (query, optional — EMPTY q must return trending, not an empty list)
images (multipart file parts, repeated — name is plural even for one file)
offset (query, numeric — this thread pages by OFFSET, not opaque cursor)
parent_id (JSON, null for a top-level comment)
reason (JSON — must be one of the keys from /v1/social/report-reasons)
